Message.Name: Gr Request Message
Message.Description: Asks the gateway router for the member's partition list. Carries the Request Message Header alone, with Partition Id sent as zero

Message.Name: Gr Response Message
Message.Description: Returns the addresses of every partition the member must connect to, together with the session key and the cryptographic material for those connections

Field.Name: MessageIndicator
Field.Description: Whether a further response follows: zero for an interim message, one for the last

Field.Name: PartitionCount
Field.Description: Count of partition details present in this message

Field.Name: IP_DETAILS_PARTITION_WISE
Field.Description: Array of up to forty partition addresses, each an IP address, port and partition Id

Field.Name: SessionKey
Field.Description: Session Key for the validated session

Field.Name: CryptographicKey
Field.Description: Cryptographic key for encrypting and decrypting every message to the allocated gateway server

Field.Name: Static Cryptographic IV
Field.Description: Static part of the Initialization Vector, which does not change

Field.Name: Dynamic Cryptographic IV
Field.Description: Dynamic part of the Initialization Vector, incremented before each encryption and decremented before each decryption

Field.Name: Cryptographic Additional Key
Field.Description: Cryptographic additional key for encrypting and decrypting every message to the allocated gateway server

Message.Name: Gr Secure User Registration Request Message
Message.Description: Declares to an allocated gateway server that the member application is using encryption. Sent unencrypted as the first message on each partition connection, carrying the Request Message Header alone

Message.Name: Gr Secure User Registration Response Message
Message.Description: Acknowledges the registration. Carries the Message Header alone, whose Error Code terminates the connection when set

Message.Name: Heartbeat Message
Message.Description: Keeps the connection alive, sent after thirty seconds of inactivity. The host disconnects the socket after two missed in succession. Carries the Request Message Header alone

Message.Name: Dc Signon In Message
Message.Description: Logs the member on to a partition of the drop copy service

Field.Name: Password
Field.Description: Password entered by the user, blank padded when shorter than eight characters

Field.Name: SessionKey
Field.Description: Session Key as received in GR_RESPONSE

Message.Name: Dc Signon Out Message
Message.Description: Confirms the logon, or terminates the connection when Error Code is set

Field.Description: User Id of the user

Field.Name: PartitionID
Field.Description: Partition or stream the packet is sent from

Field.Name: ConcurrentLoginId

Message.Description: Signs the user off the partition
